```{r}
# A. Global correlation between transcriptomic and proteomic expression levels
prot_raw <- read_excel("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/07.tissue-specific/04.pattern_heatmap/input/01.Dpse_protein_merge_LFQraw -2.xlsx")
prot_raw <- as.data.frame(prot_raw) %>%
  mutate(...1 = make.unique(...1, sep = "-")) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
prot_raw <- as.matrix(prot_raw)
prot_raw <- prot_raw[rowMeans(prot_raw) > 100000, ]

rna_raw <- read_csv("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/07.tissue-specific/04.pattern_heatmap/input/01.raw_mean_rpkm5.csv")
rna_raw <- as.data.frame(rna_raw) %>%
  mutate(...1 = make.unique(...1, sep = "-")) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "...1")
rna_raw <- as.matrix(rna_raw)
rna_raw <- rna_raw[rowSums(rna_raw) > 9, ]

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_raw), colnames(prot_raw))
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(rna_raw), rownames(prot_raw))

cat("Transcriptome number:", nrow(rna_raw), "\n",
    "Proteome number:", nrow(prot_raw), "\n",
    "Overlap:", length(common_genes), "\n")
```
```{r}
data_rna  <- rna_raw[common_genes, common_samples]
data_prot <- prot_raw[common_genes, common_samples]

if (identical(rownames(data_rna), rownames(data_prot)) && 
    identical(colnames(data_rna), colnames(data_prot))) {
  message("Proteomic and transcriptomic datasets are matched.")
} else {
  stop("Proteomic and transcriptomic datasets are not matched.")
}
```
```{r}
mean_rna <- rowMeans(data_rna)
mean_prot <- rowMeans(data_prot)
scatter_df_global <- data.frame(
  Mean_RNA = mean_rna,
  Mean_Prot = mean_prot
)

cor_res <- cor.test(scatter_df_global$Mean_RNA, scatter_df_global$Mean_Prot, 
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

r_val <- round(cor_res$estimate, 3) 
p_val <- cor_res$p.value
p_val

p_text <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 4)))
n_val <- nrow(scatter_df_global)  

stat_label <- paste0("Spearman R = ", r_val, "\n", p_text, "\nN = ", n_val)

p_global_final <- ggplot(scatter_df_global, aes(x = log10(Mean_RNA + 1), y = log10(Mean_Prot + 1))) +
  geom_point(color = "#404040", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", linetype = "solid", size = 1, se = TRUE) +
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = 0.2, y = 11.5,          
    label = stat_label, 
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,       
    size = 3.5,                 
    fontface = "italic",       
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 5),          
    breaks = seq(0, 5, 1)      
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(4, 12),         
    breaks = seq(4, 12, 2)     
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global RNA vs Protein Expression",
    x = "Log10 (Mean RPKM + 1)",
    y = "Log10 (Mean LFQ + 1)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() 
  )

print(p_global_final)
```

```{r}
# B. Correlation between male and femlae tissues
# 1. Load packages
packages <- c("ggplot2", "patchwork")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

# 2. Input and output paths
input_file <- file.choose()
output_file <- "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v5/new analysis/03_expanded_figure.pdf"
dir.create(
  dirname(output_file),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dat <- read.csv(
  input_file,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 3. Define male and female tissue groups
male_groups <- list(

  "Accessory gland" = c(
    "M_AG_1", "M_AG_2", "M_AG_3"
  ),

  "Seminal vesicle" = c(
    "M_SV_1", "M_SV_2", "M_SV_3"
  ),

  "Testis" = c(
    "M_testis_1", "M_testis_2"
  ),

  "Head" = c(
    "M_head_1", "M_head_2"
  )
)

female_groups <- list(

  "FRT" = c(
    "F_virgin_FRT_1",
    "F_virgin_FRT_2",
    "F_virgin_FRT_3"
  ),

  "Spermatheca" = c(
    "F_virgin_SP_1",
    "F_virgin_SP_2",
    "F_virgin_SP_3"
  ),

  "Ovary" = c(
    "F_ovary._1",
    "F_ovary._2"
  ),

  "Head" = c(
    "F_head._1",
    "F_head._2"
  )
)

sample_cols <- unique(c(
  unlist(male_groups),
  unlist(female_groups)
))

missing_cols <- setdiff(
  sample_cols,
  colnames(dat)
)

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Missing sample columns:",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# 4. Calculate TPM
if (any(is.na(dat$Length)) ||
    any(dat$Length <= 0)) {
  stop("Invalid gene length detected.")
}
gene_id <- dat$gene_id

count_mat <- as.matrix(
  dat[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
)

storage.mode(count_mat) <- "numeric"

count_mat[is.na(count_mat)] <- 0

rownames(count_mat) <- gene_id

rpk <- sweep(
  count_mat,
  1,
  dat$Length / 1000,
  FUN = "/"
)

tpm <- sweep(
  rpk,
  2,
  colSums(rpk),
  FUN = "/"
) * 1e6

log_tpm <- log2(tpm + 1)

# 5. Identify the 6,300 shared expressed genes (Criteria:TPM >= 1 in at least 2 biological replicates; in EACH of the four reproductive tissues:AG, SV, FRT and Spermatheca.)
expressed_in_tissue <- function(samples) {

  rowSums(
    tpm[, samples, drop = FALSE] >= 1
  ) >= 2

}

shared_genes <- (
  expressed_in_tissue(male_groups[["Accessory gland"]]) &
  expressed_in_tissue(male_groups[["Seminal vesicle"]]) &
  expressed_in_tissue(female_groups[["FRT"]]) &
  expressed_in_tissue(female_groups[["Spermatheca"]])
)

shared_genes <- rownames(tpm)[shared_genes]

cat(
  "Number of shared expressed genes:",
  length(shared_genes),
  "\n"
)

if (length(shared_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No shared expressed genes detected.")
}

# 6. Calculate mean expression for each tissue
male_mean <- sapply(
  names(male_groups),
  function(tissue) {

    rowMeans(
      log_tpm[
        shared_genes,
        male_groups[[tissue]],
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )

  }
)

female_mean <- sapply(
  names(female_groups),
  function(tissue) {

    rowMeans(
      log_tpm[
        shared_genes,
        female_groups[[tissue]],
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )

  }
)

rownames(male_mean) <- shared_genes
rownames(female_mean) <- shared_genes

# 7. Calculate all 25 Spearman correlations
correlation_function <- function(x, y) {

  test <- cor.test(
    x,
    y,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  return(
    data.frame(
      rho = as.numeric(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value,
      n = length(x)
    )
  )

}

cor_results <- list()

for (m in names(male_groups)) {

  for (f in names(female_groups)) {

    result <- correlation_function(
      male_mean[shared_genes, m],
      female_mean[shared_genes, f]
    )

    cor_results[[length(cor_results) + 1]] <-
      data.frame(
        male_tissue = m,
        female_tissue = f,
        result
      )

  }
}

cor_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  cor_results
)

cor_results$FDR <- p.adjust(
  cor_results$p_value,
  method = "BH"
)

write.csv(
  cor_results,
  sub(
    ".pdf",
    "_correlation_statistics.csv",
    output_file
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(cor_results)
```

# 8. Four reproductive-tissue scatterplots
focal_pairs <- data.frame(

  male_tissue = c(
    "Accessory gland",
    "Accessory gland",
    "Seminal vesicle",
    "Seminal vesicle"
  ),

  female_tissue = c(
    "FRT",
    "Spermatheca",
    "FRT",
    "Spermatheca"
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE

)

scatter_data <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(focal_pairs))) {

  m <- focal_pairs$male_tissue[i]
  f <- focal_pairs$female_tissue[i]

  stat <- cor_results[
    cor_results$male_tissue == m &
    cor_results$female_tissue == f,
  ]

  label <- sprintf(
    "%s vs %s\nn = %d; Spearman rho = %.3f",
    m, f, stat$n, stat$rho
  )

  scatter_data[[i]] <- data.frame(

    gene = shared_genes,

    male_expression = male_mean[
      shared_genes, m
    ],

    female_expression = female_mean[
      shared_genes, f
    ],

    comparison = label

  )

}

scatter_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  scatter_data
)

scatter_df$comparison <- factor(
  scatter_df$comparison,
  levels = unique(scatter_df$comparison)
)

p_scatter <- ggplot(

      "Male tissue mean expression: log"[2] * "(TPM + 1)"

      "Female tissue mean expression: log"[2] * "(TPM + 1)"

  theme(

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey90",
      color = "grey40"
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 9.5
    ),

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "grey65",
      fill = NA
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),

    panel.spacing = grid::unit(
      0.8, "lines"
    )

  )
p_scatter

```{r}
# C. Global correlation in each tissue

# ============================================================
# RNA-seq vs Proteomics
# Spearman correlation in 9 tissue / time-point groups
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. File paths -----------------------------------------------

rna_file <- "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v5/new analysis/01.相关性/01.Dpse_merge_rawdata2.csv"

protein_file <- "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v5/new analysis/01.相关性/Dpse_protein_merge_LFQraw.csv"

out_dir <- "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v5/new analysis/01.相关性/correlation_results"

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


# 2. Read data ------------------------------------------------

rna <- read.csv(
  rna_file,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

protein <- read.csv(
  protein_file,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove empty column names
clean_names <- function(df) {

  nm <- trimws(names(df))

  keep <- !is.na(nm) & nm != ""

  df <- df[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  nm <- nm[keep]

  names(df) <- make.unique(nm)

  return(df)
}

rna <- clean_names(rna)
protein <- clean_names(protein)

# Remove the first index column if it is present
if (ncol(protein) > 0 &&
    names(protein)[1] %in% c("X", "Unnamed: 0", "...1")) {

  first_col <- as.character(protein[[1]])

  if (all(first_col == as.character(seq_len(nrow(protein))))) {
    protein <- protein[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  }
}

# Check required columns
stopifnot(
  all(c("gene_id", "Length") %in% names(rna)),
  "Major_geneid" %in% names(protein)
)


# 3. Define actual sample columns ------------------------------

rna_groups <- list(

  "Accessory gland" =
    c("M_AG_1", "M_AG_2", "M_AG_3"),

  "Seminal vesicle" =
    c("M_SV_1", "M_SV_2", "M_SV_3"),

  "Testis" =
    c("M_testis_1", "M_testis_2"),

  "FRT - Virgin" =
    c("F_virgin_FRT_1", "F_virgin_FRT_2",
      "F_virgin_FRT_3"),

  "FRT - 6 h" =
    c("F_PM6h_FRT_1", "F_PM6h_FRT_2",
      "F_PM6h_FRT_3"),

  "FRT - 12 h" =
    c("F_PM12h_FRT_1", "F_PM12h_FRT_2",
      "F_PM12h_FRT_3"),

  "Spermatheca - Virgin" =
    c("F_virgin_SP_1", "F_virgin_SP_2",
      "F_virgin_SP_3"),

  "Spermatheca - 6 h" =
    c("F_PM6h_SP_1", "F_PM6h_SP_2",
      "F_PM6h_SP_3"),

  "Spermatheca - 12 h" =
    c("F_PM12h_SP_1", "F_PM12h_SP_2",
      "F_PM12h_SP_3")
)


protein_groups <- list(

  "Accessory gland" =
    c("AG_1", "AG_2", "AG_3"),

  "Seminal vesicle" =
    c("SV_1", "SV_2", "SV_3"),

  "Testis" =
    c("Testis_1", "Testis_2", "Testis_3"),

  "FRT - Virgin" =
    c("FRT_virgin_1", "FRT_virgin_2",
      "FRT_virgin_3"),

  "FRT - 6 h" =
    c("FRT_6h_1", "FRT_6h_2", "FRT_6h_3"),

  "FRT - 12 h" =
    c("FRT_12h_1", "FRT_12h_2", "FRT_12h_3"),

  "Spermatheca - Virgin" =
    c("SP_virgin_1", "SP_virgin_2",
      "SP_virgin_3"),

  "Spermatheca - 6 h" =
    c("SP_6h_1", "SP_6h_2", "SP_6h_3"),

  "Spermatheca - 12 h" =
    c("SP_12h_1", "SP_12h_2", "SP_12h_3")
)


# Check sample names
stopifnot(
  all(unlist(rna_groups) %in% names(rna)),
  all(unlist(protein_groups) %in% names(protein))
)


# 4. Calculate RNA TPM ----------------------------------------

valid <- !is.na(rna$gene_id) &
         !is.na(rna$Length) &
         rna$Length > 0

rna_valid <- rna[valid, ]

counts <- as.matrix(
  rna_valid[, unique(unlist(rna_groups)), drop = FALSE]
)

storage.mode(counts) <- "numeric"

gene_length <- as.numeric(rna_valid$Length)

rate <- sweep(
  counts,
  1,
  gene_length,
  "/"
)

library_size <- colSums(rate, na.rm = TRUE)

TPM <- sweep(
  rate,
  2,
  library_size,
  "/"
) * 1e6

rownames(TPM) <- as.character(rna_valid$gene_id)


# 5. Prepare protein data -------------------------------------

protein$Major_geneid <- trimws(
  as.character(protein$Major_geneid)
)

# Exclude protein groups mapped to multiple gene IDs
protein_single <- protein %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Major_geneid),
    Major_geneid != "",
    !str_detect(Major_geneid, fixed(";"))
  )

if (anyDuplicated(protein_single$Major_geneid)) {
  stop("Duplicated protein gene IDs detected.")
}

cat("RNA genes:", nrow(rna_valid), "\n")

cat("Single-gene protein groups:",
    nrow(protein_single), "\n")

cat("Exact shared gene IDs:",
    length(intersect(
      TPM |> rownames(),
      protein_single$Major_geneid
    )), "\n")


# 6. Calculate 9 independent correlations ---------------------

all_data <- list()
all_stats <- list()

for (g in names(rna_groups)) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", g, "\n")

  rna_cols <- rna_groups[[g]]
  protein_cols <- protein_groups[[g]]

  # RNA: mean TPM across biological replicates

  rna_mean <- rowMeans(
    TPM[, rna_cols, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  rna_df <- data.frame(
    gene_id = rownames(TPM),
    RNA_log2 = log2(rna_mean + 1)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(RNA_log2),
      RNA_log2 > 0
    )

  # Protein: convert zero intensity to NA

  protein_matrix <- as.matrix(
    protein_single[, protein_cols, drop = FALSE]
  )

  storage.mode(protein_matrix) <- "numeric"

  protein_matrix[
    !is.finite(protein_matrix) |
    protein_matrix <= 0
  ] <- NA_real_

  # Log2 transform each replicate

  protein_log <- log2(protein_matrix)

  # Number of detected biological replicates

  n_detected <- rowSums(!is.na(protein_log))

  # Mean log2 LFQ intensity

  protein_mean <- rowMeans(
    protein_log,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # Require detection in at least 2 replicates

  protein_mean[n_detected < 2] <- NA_real_

  protein_df <- data.frame(
    gene_id = protein_single$Major_geneid,
    Protein_log2 = protein_mean,
    n_detected = n_detected
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(Protein_log2),
      n_detected >= 2
    )

  # Match genes between the two datasets

  merged <- inner_join(
    rna_df,
    protein_df,
    by = "gene_id"
  )

  if (nrow(merged) < 3) {
    stop(paste("Insufficient shared genes:", g))
  }

  # Spearman correlation

  ct <- cor.test(
    merged$RNA_log2,
    merged$Protein_log2,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  rho <- as.numeric(ct$estimate)
  pval <- ct$p.value

  cat("Shared genes:", nrow(merged), "\n")
  cat("Spearman rho:", round(rho, 3), "\n")
  cat("P-value:", signif(pval, 4), "\n")

  # Save statistics

  all_stats[[g]] <- data.frame(
    Group = g,
    n = nrow(merged),
    Spearman_rho = rho,
    P_value = pval
  )

  merged$Group <- g

  all_data[[g]] <- merged
}


# 7. Combine results -------------------------------------------

plot_data <- bind_rows(all_data)

stats <- bind_rows(all_stats)

plot_data$Group <- factor(
  plot_data$Group,
  levels = names(rna_groups)
)

stats$Group <- factor(
  stats$Group,
  levels = names(rna_groups)
)

stats$label <- paste0(
  "n = ", stats$n,
  "\nSpearman rho = ",
  sprintf("%.3f", stats$Spearman_rho),
  "\nP = ",
  format.pval(stats$P_value, digits = 3)
)


# 8. Plot ------------------------------------------------------

p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = RNA_log2,
    y = Protein_log2
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    color = "grey55",
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "#D55E00",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = stats,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = -Inf,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.1
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~Group,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Transcript–protein abundance correlations",
    x = expression(log[2](mean~TPM + 1)),
    y = expression(mean~log[2](LFQ~intensity))
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey90"
    )
  )


# 9. Export PDF -----------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "RNA_protein_correlation_9groups.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 13,
  height = 10,
  device = "pdf"
)


# 10. Export statistics ----------------------------------------

stats_export <- stats %>%
  mutate(
    P_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")
  )

write.csv(
  stats_export,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "RNA_protein_correlation_statistics.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 11. Export matched gene data ---------------------------------

write.csv(
  plot_data,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "RNA_protein_correlation_gene_data.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 12. Display results ------------------------------------------

print(stats_export)
print(p)

cat("\nAll analyses completed!\n")

```
